parties.petitioner: Indian Evangelical Lutheran Church Trust Association

summary: Res judicata vs limitation; specific performance suit barred by Article 54 of Limitation Act; rejection of plaint in prior suit not res judicata; delay in filing second suit beyond extended limitation period; failure to explain nine-year gap between plaint rejection (12.01.1998) and fresh suit (2007); waiver inferred from acquiescence; extension letter dated 15.07.1991 irrelevant to limitation calculation; trial court and High Court erred in refusing plaint rejection under Order VII Rule 11(d) CPC.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure 1908 Order VII Rule 11(d)
Code of Civil Procedure 1908 Order VII Rule 13
Charitable and Religious Trust Act 1921 Section 7
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Civil Revision Petition upheld; plaint rejected; second suit barred by limitation; trial court order set aside.
